approval.approvalContext: The authenticated user authorized one minimal immutable v3 technical successor because the v2 1024x1536 per-frame cell cannot be extracted six times from the provider master. This decision preserves every v2 identity, style, motion and six-pose semantic value, changes only the fixed cell to 512x512, and binds deterministic 1536x1024 three-by-two row-major extraction plus six-frame 8 FPS GIF packaging acceptance. All previous decisions and handoffs remain immutable.

seojin.attack.allowed_vertical_motion.v1.value: none; preserve the support-foot ground axis across the draw, slash, and settle

value.groundContactAxis: horizontal normalized line from (0.25,0.92) to (0.75,0.92) in every 512x512 cell

seojin.attack.dark_neutral_ink_trajector.value: Use one bounded dark-neutral trajectory only at the frame-4 slash peak, subordinate to the identity contour and continuous sword path; no arbitrary speed lines, aura, magic trail, or magic VFX.

value.policy: Preserve body proportion, face, clothing, armor, sword and scabbard identity while the six frames follow one continuous root, hip, shoulder and blade trajectory with no pose duplication.

seojin.attack.hem_inertia.v13.value: The dusty gray-brown travel-robe hem drags behind the accelerating torso and blade, reaches its lag after the frame-4 peak, and settles through frames 5 and 6 without becoming a separate effect.

value.pose: Low compressed anticipation: center of mass drops, compact limbs coil, right hand stays on the left-waist hwando hilt, and the support-foot ground axis remains fixed.
Lead-foot drive and pelvis coil: the body begins forward drive while the left-waist scabbard counter-rotates against the winding torso.
Blade clearance and unwind start: the hwando clears the scabbard, shoulders and torso begin the single continuous diagonal release, and acceleration becomes visible.
Slash peak: the widest silhouette, strongest diagonal blade arc, foot pivot, weight shift and maximum torso rotation coincide at the action apex.
Overshoot and lag: the blade passes the apex once while one-shoulder armor, robe hem and gray-brown pigment flow follow one beat behind.
Controlled recovery and settle: torso and blade decelerate into a stable next-action-ready stance while identity, equipment and ground relationship remain continuous.

seojin.attack.motion_direction.v13.value: One right-handed draw-to-slash action follows a continuous low anticipation, forward drive, pelvis coil, blade clearance, torso unwind, diagonal peak, overshoot and controlled recovery; acceleration reads from frames 2 through 4, peaks at frame 4, and decelerates through frames 5 and 6.

value: Do not output a numbered storyboard, annotated contact sheet, pose guide, central trajectory diagram, or any non-playable contact-sheet-only deliverable.
Do not include text, frame numbers, captions, labels, arrows, borders, guide lines, gutters drawn as artwork, or registration marks in the master or extracted frames.
Do not crop, rescale, recenter, stretch, pad, or otherwise repair individual cells during extraction or GIF packaging.
Do not change the approved six-frame poses, timing, identity, style, equipment, sword path, root continuity, or one-shot semantics.
Do not create move, idle, eight-way, rotation, variant, another attack, or any batch beyond this one six-frame attack animation.
Do not use arbitrary speed lines, aura, magic trail, magic VFX, clean-vector treatment, or armor microdetail.
Do not treat the approved identity-reference PNG as an edit target or as authority beyond its existing reviewed visual-reference role.
Preserve the approved six-frame Seojin draw-to-slash one-shot motion, identity, style, timing, chronological frame order, and approved identity reference without semantic redesign.

Render one deterministic 1536x1024 master sheet containing exactly three columns by two rows of equal 512x512 cells in chronological row-major order: frames 0,1,2 on the top row and frames 3,4,5 on the bottom row.
Place one clean isolated full-silhouette animation frame in each 512x512 cell with the same camera, subject scale, pelvis/root point, and ground-contact axis in every cell.
Keep each full silhouette inside its 512x512 cell so packaging can split without crop, rescale, recenter, padding, or anchor correction.
Split the master only at x=0,512,1024 and y=0,512 to produce exactly six chronological 512x512 PNG frames.
Encode the six extracted PNG frames as the required looping preview GIF with exactly six frames at 125 milliseconds per frame, while the depicted attack remains one_shot.
Use artwork only in every cell: no text, numbers, captions, labels, arrows, borders, guide lines, registration marks, or central trajectory diagram.

Maintain the approved open and broken pressure-variable ink, rough watercolor and pastel flow, compact 4.25-head identity, simplified one-shoulder armor, hwando, left-waist scabbard, and six-frame continuity.

seojin.attack.scale_lock.v13.value: constant subject scale inside every 512x512 cell; full silhouette fits; identical camera, pelvis/root point and ground-contact axis; no per-frame crop, rescale, recenter, stretch, padding, or canvas change

seojin.attack.shoulder_inertia.v13.value: The simplified dusty gray-brown one-shoulder armor mass follows the torso rotation with a one-frame lag at frame 5 and settles at frame 6 without plate, scale, rivet, or material microdetail.

seojin.attack.sword_arc.v13.value: A single continuous hwando trajectory begins at the left-waist draw, clears the scabbard during torso unwind, reaches its widest strong diagonal apex at frame 4, overshoots once at frame 5, and settles without a second strike at frame 6.

seojin.attack.torso_rotation.v13.value: Torso and pelvis coil low, unwind progressively with lead-foot drive, reach maximum twist and weight transfer at frame 4, then decelerate through overshoot and recovery without reversing into another attack.
